sources.concept: Malicious HTTP/2 client interaction during server connection shutdown

impact.affected_asset: Availability of the HTTP/2 server connection and associated service capacity.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a targeted HTTP/2 server connection to enter an indefinitely hanging shutdown condition.
impact.security_effect: Denial of service through HTTP/2 server connections that can hang forever.

causal_trace.summary: A malicious client interacts with an HTTP/2 server connection while it is closing.
A clean shutdown is preempted by a subsequent fatal error, but the connection remains waiting for that clean shutdown.
The closing HTTP/2 server connection waits indefinitely for clean shutdown completion after the fatal error.
The indefinitely hanging server connection can be used to cause denial of service.

primary_invariant.statement: A closing HTTP/2 server connection must not continue waiting for clean shutdown after a subsequent fatal error has preempted that shutdown.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The reported behavior permits the connection to hang forever waiting for a clean shutdown that the fatal error preempted.

quality.review_notes: The advisory and issue explicitly establish the shutdown-preempted-by-fatal-error hang and DoS outcome, and release metadata identifies affected symbols and fixed version boundaries. The supplied CL artifact has no extracted patch/test text, so exact changed control flow, regression-test location, and an execution oracle cannot be verified from this bundle.

remediation.invariant_restored: A fatal error that preempts clean shutdown is handled so that a closing HTTP/2 server connection does not wait forever for that clean shutdown.
mitigation_classes: Terminate or otherwise handle the closing server connection when a fatal error preempts clean shutdown.

target.component: HTTP/2 server connection shutdown (http2Server/serverConn GOAWAY path)
target.project_or_package: Go standard library net/http and golang.org/x/net/http2
